scene: The trapdoor opens into an undercroft junction with three ready departures.
picture: Flat side view of a tiled underground transfer platform. On the far left sits a multi-legged bronze crawler. Up high hangs a yellow window-cleaner gondola. The player stands at centre beside the open hatch, telescope on his shoulder, facing a small red mail train waiting on tracks to the far right.
shown: a multi-legged bronze crawler idling on rails on the left
a yellow window-cleaner gondola hanging from cables up high
a small red mail train puffing steam on the right
